name: seo-fundamentals
description: Use when the user asks for an SEO audit, technical SEO, why a page is not indexed, robots.txt, sitemaps, canonical tags, noindex, hreflang, redirects, crawl budget or a traffic drop after a Google update. Produces crawl/index fixes and a Search Console workflow. Not for JSON-LD (use seo-structured-data) or framework meta tags (use frontend-seo).
